question: What ritual fruit is certainly obtained as a result of this act?
premises: The act yields a specific sacrificial fruit
The fruit is that of the agniṣṭoma
No doubt exists regarding this attainment
inference: Therefore the performer certainly obtains the fruit of the agniṣṭoma.
plain_english: Therefore one obtains the fruit of the Agniṣṭoma sacrifice; there is no doubt about it.
